q_45367.question_text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)
q_45367.reasoning:
# Analysis

**(a) Time left until resolution:**
Today is August 17, 2026. The Q2 FY2027 earnings report is scheduled for August 26, 2026 — that's **9 days away**. This is an extremely short timeframe. The forward guidance will be announced on that date.

**(b) Most likely outcome and why:**

The research provides NVIDIA's Q1 FY2027 guidance from May 20, 2026: **$91.0 billion ± 2%** for Q2 FY2027. This is the company's own official forward guidance, freshly issued just a few months ago (approximately 3 months before the earnings date).

The critical factors:
- NVIDIA explicitly stated this guidance assumes **zero China Data Center compute revenue**
- Analyst consensus aligns closely around $91-93.5 billion
- The guidance range of ±2% creates a band of $89.18B to $92.82B
- Any China sales clearance during Q2 would represent upside to the stated $91B base

Given we are only 9 days from the earnings report, NVIDIA's guidance is unlikely to change materially from what was already stated in May. Companies typically maintain their guidance unless there's a major unexpected development. The research indicates strong alignment between the May guidance and analyst expectations.

The most likely outcome is that **Q2 FY2027 forward guidance will be in the range of $89-93 billion**, with the central estimate around $91 billion.

**(c) What would push the value lower?**
- Unexpected weakness in demand signals between May and August
- Deterioration in enterprise spending or AI capex cycles
- Additional geopolitical restrictions on China sales
- Macro deterioration affecting customer orders
- Actual Q2 results materially below guidance (though this wouldn't change forward guidance, it could affect Q3 guidance)

**(d) What would push the value higher?**
- Better-than-expected Q2 actual results boosting confidence
- Unexpected China sales clearance or regulatory relief
- Acceleration in AI adoption/demand signals
- Mix shift toward higher-margin products
- Macro tailwinds boosting customer confidence
- Competitive dynamics favoring NVIDIA

**(e) Base rate or historical reference values:**

From the research: NVIDIA's stated Q2 FY2027 forward guidance is **$91.0 billion ± 2%** (issued May 20, 2026). Analyst consensus clusters around $91-93.5 billion. This is the most recent and most reliable specific data point available.

---

## Probability Distribution Reasoning:

Given:
- Only 9 days until announcement
- Company's official May guidance of $91B ± 2% is still current
- Strong analyst alignment with this guidance
- No recent major developments suggesting significant deviation
- The range provided (99.5-115.5B) sits well above both the stated guidance and analyst consensus

The distribution should be:
- **Concentrated tightly around $91 billion** with relatively tight standard deviation
- Small probability of modest upside (China sales, stronger execution)
- Small probability of downside (demand weakness)
- Very low probability of extreme moves in either direction given the short timeframe and recent guidance

The 99.5B lower bound is ~9.4% above the $91B guidance center. This would require material positive surprise. The 115.5B upper bound would require exceptional upside well beyond any analyst expectations.

My estimate focuses on the $89-93B range with modal outcome at $91B, reflecting NVIDIA's stated guidance and the minimal time for material change.

Low (10th percentile): 89180000000
Median (50th percentile): 91000000000
High (90th percentile): 93500000000
q_45367.research_text:
NVIDIA's forward guidance for Q2 FY2027 revenue, as provided in its Q1 FY2027 earnings release on May 20, 2026, is $91.0 billion, plus or minus 2% [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm). This guidance explicitly assumes no Data Center compute revenue from China [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm), [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027.html).

Analysts' expectations for Q2 FY2027 revenue generally align with NVIDIA's guidance, with Barchart citing revenue near $91 billion and other aggregators pegging it closer to $93.5 billion [news.ifyouspent.com](https://news.ifyouspent.com/en/news/nvidia-earnings-what-to-watch-august-2026). The actual Q2 FY2027 earnings report is scheduled for August 26, 2026 [news.ifyouspent.com](https://news.ifyouspent.com/en/news/nvidia-earnings-what-to-watch-august-2026). Any China sales that clear during the quarter would represent upside to the $91 billion guidance [news.ifyouspent.com](https://news.ifyouspent.com/en/news/nvidia-earnings-what-to-watch-august-2026).
